article.story: HARRISONBURG, Va. -- — Brandon Lee scored 20 points as James Madison beat Charleston Southern 82-58 on Tuesday night. Lee added five rebounds for the Dukes (5-2). K.J. Windham scored 15 points, going 6 of 13 (3 for 7 from 3-point range). Adrian Myers shot 4 of 10 from the field and 4 of 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Jefferson McLamb finished with 18 points for the Buccaneers (2-5). Charleston Southern also got 10 points, 10 rebounds and three blocks from Lase Olalere. DJ Hubbard finished with 10 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
